onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: The duration of the sound stimulus in seconds.

crosstalk_dir.Description: The ratio to which the pulse is played from the left or right speaker. A value of 1 means the pulse is played only from the right side, and a value of 0 means the pulse is played equally from both speakers.

crosstalk_freq.Description: The ratio to which the pulses are being modulated in frequency.

bup_width.Description: The duration of a single pulse in milliseconds.

bup_ramp.Description: The duration of the ramp of a single pulse in milliseconds.

vol_low.Description: The multiplier of the volume of the low frequency tone.

vol_hi.Description: The multiplier of the volume of the high frequency tone.

vol.Description: The overall volume multiplier of the sound stimulus.

gamma_dir.Description: Log ratio of average right vs. left pulse rates per second; zero means equal, positive means more pulses come from the right speaker, negative means more left.

gamma_freq.Description: Log ratio of average high vs. low frequency pulses per second; zero means equal, positive means more high frequency pulses, negative means more low frequency pulses.

freq_lo.Description: The frequency of the low fequency pulse in Herz.

freq_hi.Description: The frequency of the high frequency pulse in Herz.

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
Levels.states: The 'states' table in the NWB file.

trials.Description: Contains the start and stop times of each trial in the task.

states.Description: Contains the start and stop times of each state in the task.
